items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: And Jack would take them off. For this other band, for the big band.

ctx.x: And Jack would take them off. For this other band, for the big band. And then, you see, I didn't have to fool with that. I never did care for a job like that. That extraction.
Bud says he wrote some arrangements for that band, too. Do you recall that? Bud Johnson.
